tool_use.research: read_inputs once; read_pages over line:<n> for every cited line (ranges in tool_calls.research); search_pack over each searched item backs each not_found answer
tool_use.CP-DR: brief: read_inputs once; source scope every held non-ev source (identity and financial in this pack), zero ev-* reads; research: read_inputs once, ok read_pages over line:<n> for every cited line, TDR.4, TDR.5 and TDR.6 citations included (ranges in tool_calls.research), search_pack over each searched item backs each not_found answer
tool_use.CP-1C: read_inputs once (the module_context view, CP-DR upstream row included); ok read_pages over line:<n> of every ev-* line the assessments cite (range in tool_calls.cp1c); source scope identity, financial and every held ev-* item, no peers source; the figures come from the TDR.6 head facts, not from a model quote
